_comment: A two-question checklist, for walking the app end to end in a minute rather
than answering 101 questions. Not for real use.
npm run db:seed:demo        switch to it
npm run checklist           see which version is live
npm run checklist 13        switch back to the real one
It publishes as version 100, beside the real checklist rather than over it.
Inspections already recorded keep pointing at the version they were carried
out under, so nothing you have already done is disturbed.
Two questions, chosen to exercise most of what the app does:
1. a CRITICAL rating - failing it requires a note AND a photograph, and
caps the whole inspection at 'Serious finding' whatever the score.
2. a NUMBER with a session counter and a per-size target - it puts a
tap-to-count button on the top bar, and a count below the target for
the centre's size is flagged as an improvement point.
'centres' is empty on purpose: the seed only ever adds missing centres, so
this leaves the 23 real ones alone.

items.guide: Walk the route a child would take. Every exit, not the nearest one.
dos: Open each door and check it swings clear
Look for anything stored in the corridor
donts: Take the centre's word for it

large.text: A large centre will have more than one route out. Check them all.

items.text: How many students are in the session?
items.guide: Count heads at the busiest point, not as they arrive.
